title: Define reproducible gf2-core SOTA reference matrix
description:
Define the reproducible SOTA reference matrix for gf2-core finite-field and linear-algebra performance.

## Background

fflas-ffpack and M4RI are primary hard references, but GF(2^m), charpoly/minpoly, and sparse operations may require M4RIE, LinBox, NTL, or FLINT. Only reproducible and comparable references become hard targets.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A linked design doc defines the reference acceptance protocol and the reference owner for every in-scope operation/field family.
- [hard] fflas-ffpack and M4RI lanes are hardened for the primary GF(p) and GF(2) comparisons.
- [hard] M4RIE, LinBox, NTL, and FLINT are either promoted to hard references with working harnesses or rejected with evidence.
